To: Sofia Marchetti; Kwame Adjei-Rowe  
Subject: Coverage while Sofia is out  
Date: Apr 24th, 2026

Hi both—

Quick coverage note before I disappear into the afternoon queue.

Sofia is on leave May 4th through Jun 12th, 2026, back Jun 15th. I’ll cover Pellow Home Living as acting AM during that window. Sofia remains the owner. Coverage only—not an ownership change.

Sofia, please send the open-items list before you log off next Friday. Especially the receiving supervisor’s screenshots from door 7, the duplicate appointment issue on the early shift, and whatever came back on the “Inbound arrivals by hour” export. I found two versions in the shared folder; one still has the old Covey & Lark Retail header. Will clean that up.

I’ll handle customer replies and keep the running notes in the Pellow Home Living handover page. Please use the full account name in subject lines, not PHL. Too easy to grab the wrong thread when rushing.

Kwame—if something lands with you by accident, forward it straight over. No need to untangle it first.

Need the latest contact list too. The number on last week’s dock walk-through invite bounced me into a warehouse voicemail loop. Fun.

Will sort the calender holds Monday.

---

**Forwarded message**  
From: Sofia Marchetti  
To: Bettina Kroll  
Date: Apr 24th, 2026  
Subject: Pellow Home Living handover bits

Thanks. I’ll send the list Friday. Door 7 screenshots are in the support thread; export example still coming from the morning receiving team. I’ve asked them to include the selected date range this time.
